detailed_description:
The target video is original 2004 PlayStation 2 open-world gameplay footage with angular low-poly characters, flat painted textures, simple diffuse shading and warm hazy light, framed as vertical 9:16. Every person shares the same painted PS2 character style.
[Shot 1] The shot continues from the last frame of <Video 1> without any change in lighting, colour, framing or camera speed. <Subject 2>, the woman with the long black ponytail in the maroon sleeveless top, maroon leggings and white trainers, is partway down a squat on the yellow mat; she finishes it and keeps squatting at the same steady rhythm, hips back, knees over her toes, arms rising straight out in front as she lowers and returning to her sides as she stands, heels flat on the mat. <Subject 4>, the woman with the short black bob in the black short-sleeve top with the small red mark on her left chest and black leggings, stands beside her on the right, watching. She nods twice, then claps her hands together twice in encouragement and lowers her hands to her sides. Both women keep their hands, fingers and feet clearly visible, and each keeps her own face, hair and clothes. The camera keeps arcing slowly to the right around them with small amplitude at slow speed, as it was moving at the end of <Video 1>, with the horizon level. These two women are the only people in the room, and every surface keeps the painted PS2 look of <Subject 1>.
